title: Railminder Station Dataset
description: Bundled offline dataset for KRL Commuter Line (Jabodetabek). Loaded from assets/data/krl_stations.json at app start.

version.description: Dataset version, ISO-8601 date of last verification (YYYY-MM-DD).

id.description: Official KRL station code, unique across the dataset.

name.description: Display name as shown to passengers.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude, constrained to Jabodetabek and surrounding KRL service area.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude, constrained to the Jabodetabek KRL service area including the Rangkasbitung terminus.

orderIndex.description: Default ordering within the primary line, used for search ranking.

$comment: Cross-field validation (not expressible in JSON Schema) is enforced by StationRepository.validate(): every lineId referenced by a station exists in lines[], every stationId referenced by a line exists in stations[], station ids are unique, and each line's stationIds are ordered from one terminus to the other.
